intended_object: A chart on M around x, chosen via `Classical.choose` from the witnesses that `f` is a submersion at `x`. In this chart (together with `codChart` and `equiv`), `f` looks like a projection. This is what the docstring says.
explanation: The definition extracts one witness from the existential data in `IsSubmersionAt`, namely the domain chart of the local normal form. It does this by passing through `IsSubmersionAtOfComplement.domChart`. The docstring itself says the particular chart is arbitrary. So this is an API accessor, an implementation device for working with the submersion predicate, not a mathematical notion that can be checked against a definition in the literature. It is correctly set up to match `codChart` and `equiv`, since all three come from the same `isSubmersionAtOfComplement_complement` witness.
